initializationAction: q.run_command('execute as ' + q.player.username + ' run function sinnoh:triggers/stopsound');

pages.speaker: npc
lines: I might've said it before, but you're really tough! Wasn't it hard for you to raise your Pokémon to be so good? I guess that's a measure of how much you love your Pokémon. In recognition of that, I proudly grant you this! ' + q.player.username + ' received the Forest Badge from Gardenia! With the Forest Badge, your Pokémon can use the hidden move Cut outside of battle. I've also got something else. It's a gift from me! That TM contains the move Grass Knot. It's one of my favorite moves. The heavier the foe, the more damage this move will cause. Yup! If there's one thing I can tell about you, it's this! You and your Pokémon are gonna get even tougher, and I mean seriously!
